digest.component_or_area: Claude Code MCP tool integration and session startup
propositions: Serena symbol tools are deferred by default, requiring a ToolSearch round-trip before first use while other tools like Bash incur zero discovery cost, creating friction asymmetry that favors cheaper tools regardless of documentation
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is an all-or-nothing global control (no per-tool or per-server granularity), so the original AC to limit always-loaded schemas to <=4 Serena tools is not implementable

Loading all Serena schemas (~25 tools) to un-defer symbol tools adds a floor cost of 25k tokens in isolation or 64k tokens with typical 4-server MCP surface, and this cost is justified by prior defect impact but must be measured and documented

A repo-committed .claude/settings.json with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH negation in .gitignore can make symbol tools resident with a one-line revert, and the actual token delta must be recorded to justify the choice between false and auto:N
